name: offline-ocr-scanner
description: Offline OCR scanner: turn photos of documents into text with Tesseract.js, in your browser

paragraphs: Turn photos of documents into text. Take a picture or upload an image or PDF, let the app find the page, flatten its perspective and straighten the text, then read it with Tesseract. You get editable text, a TXT download or a searchable PDF. Everything runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded, and after the first use it works offline.
features: Many ways in. Live camera (getUserMedia, with the phone's camera app as a fallback), image and PDF upload (pdf.js renders each page), paste from the clipboard, or drag and drop.

Document scanner pre-processing. Automatic page detection, draggable 4-corner crop with perspective correction (own homography implementation), rotate, automatic or manual deskew, grayscale, contrast enhancement and…
Tesseract.js v7 in a worker. Multi-select languages (English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Polish and more); progress and confidence are shown.
Word boxes drawn over the page, coloured by confidence, with the word shown on hover.
Editable text, copy, download TXT, one-click clean-up (dehyphenation, ligatures, optional paragraph reflow).
